offering_description.value: Owns and operates upscale steakhouse and Japanese-style restaurants, plus licensed restaurants run by partners. Serves dining guests, groups and private-event customers, and earns money from food and beverage sales and brand licensing.

primary_products.value: steaks and seafood; sushi and Japanese dishes; cocktails and wine

primary_services.value: restaurant dining; private dining and events; hospitality management; brand licensing

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual diners and special-occasion guests; B2B: corporate event planners and private groups booking dining events

end_markets.value: restaurants and dining; hospitality; corporate events

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverages sold to dining guests at company-operated restaurants; licensing or royalties: royalties from partner-operated licensed restaurants

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates restaurants and sells dining experiences directly to guests; brand owner: owns restaurant brands and licenses them to outside operators

geography_served.value: global: US restaurants in multiple states plus licensed locations in international cities such as London, Dubai and Hong Kong

specialization.value: related lines: STK steakhouses, Kona Grill casual dining, and Benihana Japanese restaurants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants serving guests directly; partners / resellers: licensed restaurant partners operating under company brands; online: online reservations and delivery orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state and local liquor licenses, food safety and health codes, and employment and labor rules

notes: Brand portfolio and international licensing footprint may have changed; details on which brands are currently owned are uncertain.
